title: DOCX Editor: edit Word files inside TYPO3
description: Edit a Word file where it is stored, open any page as a Word document, or keep your own word processor: download the page, change it in Word or LibreOffice, upload it and review every change before the import. Recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Product film, 125 seconds: DOCX Editor for TYPO3 v14. A Word file opens from the file list, is edited and saved back; a second editor causes a warning instead of an overwrite; a page opens as a Word document, is edited and reviewed before import; the page is downloaded, edited in Microsoft Word and uploaded again with a review of the Word changes; a long document becomes new pages. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: One fix in a Word file means download, edit, upload, and hoping nobody changed it.
Between Word and TYPO3, copy and paste breaks the formatting.
DOCX Editor brings Word into TYPO3, in both directions.
Click Edit DOCX next to any Word file in the file list.
It opens full page, in Word’s own layout.
Type, save, and the change lands in the same file.
Tracked changes and comments survive the save.
A badge shows how many editors have the file open.
If someone saved first, your save stops and offers a reload.
Any page opens as a Word document.
Each element becomes a framed block you can edit.
Edit the text in the browser.
A review lists every change before anything reaches the page.
Or download the page, and keep your own word processor.
Edit it in Word, LibreOffice or any other editor. Here, two sentences changed in Microsoft Word.
Upload it again, and the review shows what changed in Word.
Import, and the page is up to date.
A long document can become new pages, one per Heading 1.
Each part gets a suggested content type, and new pages start hidden.
DOCX Editor. Open source, for TYPO3 v14.
